title: Stanford Energy Seminar | The Renewables Reckoning: Bankruptcies, Buyouts, and America's Energy Supply
description: Join us for a discussion on the current state of the renewables sector — from bankruptcies and buyouts to what it means for America's energy supply.

title: Space-Based Data Centers: Energy and Sustainability Implications
description: A seminar exploring the feasibility and sustainability implications of space-based data center infrastructure.

title: Big Earth Hackathon: Wildland Fire Challenge
description: A multi-day hackathon focused on applying big data and technology to wildland fire challenges. Open to all Stanford students.

title: Indigenous-Led Pathways: Dinner and Discussion
description: An evening dinner and discussion exploring Indigenous-led approaches to sustainability and environmental stewardship.

title: Sustainability in Practice: Partnering for Impact
description: A session on building effective partnerships for sustainability impact, featuring practitioners from industry and academia.

title: The Electrification Trend: What It Means for Energy
who: Dr. Diana Gragg, Managing Director, Precourt Institute for Energy
description: A short and interactive presentation on the electrification trend and its implications for the energy landscape, by Dr. Diana Gragg of Stanford's Precourt Institute for Energy.

title: SDSS Alumni Awards Reception — Honoring Tim Latimer (Fervo Energy)
description: Join us to celebrate the 2026 SDSS Alumni Award recipients, including Tim Latimer, MS '17 and founder of Fervo Energy, a leader in next-generation geothermal.

title: Energy & Sustainability Alumni-Student Mixer and Brunch
who: Stanford Energy Club & Doerr School of Sustainability
description: Connect with Stanford Energy and Sustainability alumni and current students over brunch. A great opportunity for mentorship, networking, and community building.

title: Stanford Energy Seminar | Powering What's Next: Real Estate's Role in the Energy Transition
who: Susan Uthayakumar, Chief Energy & Sustainability Officer, Prologis
description: How the world's largest logistics real estate company is driving clean energy procurement, on-site solar, and energy efficiency across its global portfolio.

title: 2026 Explore Energy Expo
who: Precourt Institute for Energy / Explore Energy
description: The annual Explore Energy Expo features Stanford student clubs and professional groups doing energy-related work across campus. Come learn about opportunities to get involved!

title: Fuels of the Future: Pathways for Hard-to-Abate Sectors
description: A full-day workshop exploring pathways to decarbonize hard-to-abate sectors including shipping, aviation, and heavy industry through alternative fuels and technologies.

title: Energy at the Nexus: Systems, Materials, Data, and Society
description: The inaugural Precourt Institute for Energy partner convening, bringing together industry, academia, and policymakers to explore the intersections of energy systems, materials, data, and society.
